title: A price in litres with no density
why: Kovai priced glycerin per litre and gave no density, so it can't be compared per kg. The system must not guess. It asks, waits, then re-ranks when the answer arrives.

chat.text: Please find our offer attached. We use our own format as our ERP generates this, hope that is OK.

Dear R. Selvam,

Thank you for your offer and the propanediol COA. We will review the offer in your format. To complete our evaluation, please provide the following:

1. RM-002 Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade): your offer is quoted per litre but no density is given, so we cannot convert to kg. Please state the density of the glycerin in g/mL or kg/L, with the temperature at which it applies, and confirm the quoted price per kg.

2. Certificate of Analysis (COA) from a recent batch for each of the 10 lines (RM-001 to RM-010), showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. We have the propanediol COA; please send the other nine.

3. Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for each of the 10 lines, and written confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.

Please reply with the items numbered as above. Thank you.

Regards,
Procurement Manager, Coimbatore plant
Kesavi Personal Care
detail: The plant manager approved this draft, and it was sent.

chat.text: Before the answer, glycerin is recommended to Vembanad. Kovai can't be ranked yet.
Dear Team, density of our refined glycerine is 1.26 g/ml at 25C. Regards, R. Selvam

detail: Orchestrator: New message received. Agents activated.

Intake Router: Classified as other: Kovai Finechem (R. Selvam) states the density of their refined glycerine as 1.26 g/ml at 25C, providing a technical data point with no commercial terms, no offer, no question, and no request for sensitive information.
Model router: Extraction sent to Haiku: text documents.

Document Extractor: Updated the database: 1 lines. Vendor V01 (Kovai Finechem) follow-up email gives density 1.26 g/ml at 25C for Refined Glycerine, saved to RM-002; the email does not answer the COA, SDS, or cosmetic-suitability requests, and the stored record's claims are unchanged.
Questionnaire Analyst: Recorded 1 answers. Now 100% answered, 78% backed by evidence.
Rule engine: Normalised 6 of 7 lines to rupees per spec kg. 0 open question(s), 1 risk flag(s). Evaluation data updated.
Vendor Liaison: Drafted an email covering 2 point(s). Waiting for approval.

chat.text: Glycerin now goes to Kovai. Rs 0.70/kg dearer than Vembanad, but its MOQ is 200 kg against 500 kg, so holding stock costs less.

checks.rule: Kovai's glycerin price was read as per litre
No price per kg was guessed
A question about density was drafted for approval
The density answer converted the price: 142 / 1.26 = Rs 112.70 per kg
Glycerin is now recommended to Kovai
